title: ESPR Explained: The Regulation Behind Digital Product Passports for (Nearly) Every Product
subtitle: A comprehensive guide to the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation 2024/1781 — scope, DPP requirements, delegated acts timeline, and what it means for your business
excerpt: The ESPR (Regulation 2024/1781) is the EU's most ambitious product sustainability framework — requiring Digital Product Passports, ecodesign requirements, and substance of concern declarations for nearly all physical products. This guide explains how the ESPR works, which product groups come first, and what businesses should do now.
